epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Integration with a payment gateway (Stripe) for credit card payments, subscription management, and payment event handling

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for secure credit card transactions
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully processes a credit card payment and updates the order status
The system handles declined credit card payments and displays an error message to the customer

tasks.title: Set up Stripe payment gateway API
tasks.description: Configure Stripe API keys and set up payment processing

tasks.title: Implement credit card payment form and validation
tasks.description: Create a secure payment form with credit card number, expiration date, and CVV validation

tasks.title: Handle payment processing and error handling
tasks.description: Integrate payment processing with Stripe API and handle successful and declined payments

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my recurring payments
acceptance_criteria: The system allows customers to update their subscription plans and payment methods
The system cancels subscriptions and stops recurring payments when requested by the customer

tasks.title: Implement subscription plan management with Stripe
tasks.description: Create, update, and delete subscription plans using Stripe API

tasks.title: Develop subscription management UI for customers
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for customers to manage their subscriptions

tasks.title: Handle subscription updates and cancellations with Stripe webhooks
tasks.description: Integrate Stripe webhooks to update subscription status and cancel recurring payments

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive payment event notifications, so that I can track and manage payment-related activities
stories.description: Implement payment event handling and notification system
acceptance_criteria: The system sends email notifications to administrators for successful payments and subscription updates
The system logs payment events and errors for auditing and debugging purposes

tasks.title: Set up Stripe webhooks for payment events
tasks.description: Configure Stripe webhooks to receive payment event notifications

tasks.title: Develop payment event handling and logging system
tasks.description: Create a system to handle payment events, log errors, and send notifications

tasks.title: Implement email notification system for payment events
tasks.description: Create email templates and integrate with the payment event handling system

epics.title: User Authentication System
epics.description: A comprehensive system for user authentication, including login, signup, password reset, and OAuth integration

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using email and password, so that I can access the application
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their email and password
acceptance_criteria: The system should validate the user's email and password
The system should redirect the user to the dashboard after successful login
The system should display an error message for invalid email or password

tasks.title: Implement email and password validation
tasks.description: Create a function to validate user email and password

tasks.title: Create login form and handle form submission
tasks.description: Design and implement the login form, and handle form submission

tasks.title: Implement login redirect and error handling
tasks.description: Redirect the user to the dashboard after successful login, and display an error message for invalid credentials

stories.title: As a user, I want to signup for the system using email and password, so that I can create an account
stories.description: The system should allow users to signup using their email and password
acceptance_criteria: The system should validate the user's email and password during signup
The system should create a new user account after successful signup
The system should send a verification email to the user after signup

tasks.title: Implement email and password validation during signup
tasks.description: Create a function to validate user email and password during signup

tasks.title: Create signup form and handle form submission
tasks.description: Design and implement the signup form, and handle form submission

tasks.title: Implement user account creation and verification email sending
tasks.description: Create a new user account after successful signup, and send a verification email to the user

stories.title: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can recover my account
stories.description: The system should allow users to reset their password
acceptance_criteria: The system should send a password reset email to the user
The system should allow the user to reset their password using the reset link
The system should update the user's password after successful reset

tasks.title: Implement password reset email sending
tasks.description: Create a function to send a password reset email to the user

tasks.title: Create password reset form and handle form submission
tasks.description: Design and implement the password reset form, and handle form submission

tasks.title: Implement password update after successful reset
tasks.description: Update the user's password after successful reset

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using OAuth, so that I can access the application using my social media accounts
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using OAuth
acceptance_criteria: The system should redirect the user to the OAuth authorization page
The system should handle the OAuth callback and authenticate the user
The system should create a new user account if the user does not exist

tasks.title: Implement OAuth authorization redirect
tasks.description: Redirect the user to the OAuth authorization page

tasks.title: Handle OAuth callback and authenticate the user
tasks.description: Handle the OAuth callback and authenticate the user

tasks.title: Implement user account creation for new OAuth users
tasks.description: Create a new user account if the user does not exist

epics.title: Email Notification System
epics.description: A system for sending transactional emails to users for important events

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive welcome emails, so that I feel engaged with the platform
stories.description: The system should send a welcome email to new users with a personalized message and a link to get started
acceptance_criteria: The welcome email is sent to the user's registered email address within 1 minute of account creation
The welcome email contains a personalized greeting with the user's name
The welcome email contains a link to the platform's getting started page

tasks.title: Implement email template for welcome emails
tasks.description: Design and implement a template for welcome emails with placeholders for user name and getting started link

tasks.title: Integrate welcome email sending with user registration
tasks.description: Modify the user registration process to trigger the sending of a welcome email

tasks.title: Test welcome email sending functionality
tasks.description: Test the welcome email sending functionality with different user registration scenarios

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive password reset links, so that I can recover my account
stories.description: The system should send a password reset link to the user's registered email address when they request a password reset
acceptance_criteria: The password reset link is sent to the user's registered email address within 1 minute of requesting a password reset
The password reset link is valid for 30 minutes and can be used to reset the user's password
The password reset link is unique to the user's account and cannot be used to reset another user's password

tasks.title: Implement password reset link generation
tasks.description: Generate a unique password reset link for each user's account

tasks.title: Integrate password reset link sending with password reset request
tasks.description: Modify the password reset request process to trigger the sending of a password reset link

tasks.title: Test password reset link functionality
tasks.description: Test the password reset link functionality with different password reset scenarios

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive payment receipts, so that I can keep track of my transactions
stories.description: The system should send a payment receipt to the user's registered email address after a successful payment
acceptance_criteria: The payment receipt is sent to the user's registered email address within 1 minute of a successful payment
The payment receipt contains the payment amount, payment method, and transaction date
The payment receipt contains a link to the user's transaction history

tasks.title: Implement payment receipt email template
tasks.description: Design and implement a template for payment receipts with placeholders for payment amount, payment method, and transaction date

tasks.title: Integrate payment receipt sending with payment processing
tasks.description: Modify the payment processing process to trigger the sending of a payment receipt

tasks.title: Test payment receipt sending functionality
tasks.description: Test the payment receipt sending functionality with different payment scenarios

stories.title: As a developer, I want to integrate the email notification system with SendGrid or AWS SES, so that I can reliably send emails
stories.description: The system should integrate with a reliable email service provider to send transactional emails
acceptance_criteria: The system can send emails using SendGrid or AWS SES
The system can handle email sending failures and retries
The system can track email sending metrics such as delivery rate and bounce rate

tasks.title: Research and choose an email service provider
tasks.description: Research and choose between SendGrid and AWS SES as the email service provider

tasks.title: Implement integration with chosen email service provider
tasks.description: Implement the integration with the chosen email service provider using their API

tasks.title: Test email sending functionality with chosen provider
tasks.description: Test the email sending functionality with the chosen email service provider

epics.title: Admin Dashboard
epics.description: A dashboard for internal team to manage users, monitor the platform, and view analytics

stories.title: As an admin, I want to manage user accounts, so that I can control access to the platform
stories.description: The admin dashboard should allow administrators to create, edit, and delete user accounts, as well as assign roles and permissions.
acceptance_criteria: The admin can create a new user account with a unique username and password.
The admin can edit an existing user account, including changing the username, password, and role.
The admin can delete a user account, and all associated data is removed from the system.
The system prevents duplicate usernames and ensures password strength.

tasks.title: Design and implement user account creation form
tasks.description: Create a form that allows admins to input user details and assign roles.

tasks.title: Develop user account editing functionality
tasks.description: Create a feature that allows admins to edit existing user accounts.

tasks.title: Implement user account deletion with data removal
tasks.description: Create a feature that allows admins to delete user accounts and remove associated data.

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view analytics dashboards, so that I can monitor platform performance
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display key metrics and analytics, such as active users, revenue, and system performance.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays the number of active users in real-time.
The dashboard displays revenue metrics, including total revenue and revenue by date range.
The dashboard displays system performance metrics, including response time and error rate.
The dashboard allows admins to filter metrics by date range and other relevant criteria.

tasks.title: Design and implement analytics dashboard layout
tasks.description: Create a layout that displays key metrics and analytics in a clear and intuitive way.

tasks.title: Develop data visualization components for analytics dashboard
tasks.description: Create visualizations that display metrics and analytics in a clear and engaging way.

tasks.title: Implement data filtering and sorting for analytics dashboard
tasks.description: Create features that allow admins to filter and sort metrics and analytics by relevant criteria.

stories.title: As an admin, I want to monitor system health, so that I can identify and resolve issues
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display system health metrics, such as error logs and system performance.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays error logs in real-time, including error messages and timestamps.
The dashboard displays system performance metrics, including CPU usage and memory usage.
The dashboard allows admins to filter error logs by date range and error type.
The dashboard sends notifications to admins when system health metrics exceed threshold values.

tasks.title: Design and implement system health dashboard layout
tasks.description: Create a layout that displays system health metrics in a clear and intuitive way.

tasks.title: Develop data visualization components for system health dashboard
tasks.description: Create visualizations that display system health metrics in a clear and engaging way.

tasks.title: Implement notification system for system health metrics
tasks.description: Create a feature that sends notifications to admins when system health metrics exceed threshold values.

stories.title: As an admin, I want to manage configuration settings, so that I can customize the platform
stories.description: The admin dashboard should allow administrators to manage configuration settings, such as API keys and integration settings.
acceptance_criteria: The admin can view and edit configuration settings, including API keys and integration settings.
The system validates configuration settings to ensure they are valid and properly formatted.
The system prevents admins from saving invalid or incomplete configuration settings.
The system displays a confirmation message when configuration settings are saved successfully.

tasks.title: Design and implement configuration settings form
tasks.description: Create a form that allows admins to input and edit configuration settings.

tasks.title: Develop validation and error handling for configuration settings
tasks.description: Create features that validate and handle errors for configuration settings.

tasks.title: Implement confirmation messaging for configuration settings
tasks.description: Create a feature that displays a confirmation message when configuration settings are saved successfully.

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view real-time analytics, so that I can monitor platform activity
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display real-time analytics, such as active users and system performance.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays real-time analytics, including active users and system performance.
The dashboard updates analytics in real-time, without requiring a page refresh.
The dashboard allows admins to filter analytics by date range and other relevant criteria.
The dashboard displays a warning message when real-time analytics are unavailable due to system issues.

tasks.title: Design and implement real-time analytics dashboard layout
tasks.description: Create a layout that displays real-time analytics in a clear and intuitive way.

tasks.title: Develop WebSockets or Webhooks for real-time analytics updates
tasks.description: Create a feature that updates analytics in real-time using WebSockets or Webhooks.

tasks.title: Implement error handling and warning messaging for real-time analytics
tasks.description: Create features that handle errors and display warning messages when real-time analytics are unavailable.
